cohort: The study included 43 women in their third trimester of pregnancy and 35 non-pregnant women attending routine care at a hospital clinic.
finding: Serum markers of B-cell kinetics change during pregnancy, often persisting into the postpartum period and affecting immunoglobulin secretion.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken during the third trimester of pregnancy, on the day of delivery, and during the postpartum period.
